clips.title: The story
paras: Warriors who have mastered the berserker stance are sent north to find The Windwatcher. After the Affray on Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod points them toward a weapon worthy of their fury.

You have survived the Affray on Fray Island and learned the berserker stance from Klannoc Macleod. Now Klannoc sends you far from the Barrens coast, across continents, to find a solitary craftsman who can forge an exceptional weapon.

Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives beside the river that runs north past Tarren Mill. His camp rests among stone ruins in the contested land between the Alterac Mountains and the blighted Western Plaguelands. The troll hermit crafts weapons and commands potent elemental shamanism. He waits for warriors determined to forge a weapon of great power.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've learned your berserker's stance, you'll want a nice weapon to use it with.
Talk to Bath'rah the Windwatcher, a troll hermit who lives between the Alterac Mountains and the Western Plaguelands. He is a skilled weapon maker and a powerful shaman.
To find Bath'rah, go to the river that flows along Tarren Mill's eastern flank. Follow it north--Bath'rah is camped near ruins that rest along the river's eastern bank.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have traveled far, young warrior. I see fire in your eyes. You seek a weapon of great power, yes?
I can help you with your quest. And you can help me with mine.
